expected.title: Deformation-uniform Beauville–Bogomolov bounds ensuring pseudoeffectivity of twisted cotangent classes on compact irreducible holomorphic symplectic manifolds
expected.author: Fabrizio Anella; Andreas Höring
expected.difficulty_reason: The cited Kähler-cone criterion does not provide a single threshold across all relevant cycle classes and all members of the deformation family. The authors reduce the cycle intersections to Beauville--Bogomolov polynomials and prove a uniform largest-root bound. The complete positive-current compactness and specialization argument in Diverio's Appendix then transfers very-general positivity to the arbitrary member and the boundary nef-and-big case.
